# KitchenTrusted

> KitchenTrusted publishes practical kitchen product reviews, buying guides, category pages, and design inspiration to help people compare options for their homes.

## Browse the site

- [Kitchen product categories](https://kitchen-reviews-seven.vercel.app/categories): Browse cookware, small appliances, sinks, faucets, storage, and other kitchen categories.
- [Kitchen products](https://kitchen-reviews-seven.vercel.app/products): Explore product recommendations and compare options.
- [Buying guides](https://kitchen-reviews-seven.vercel.app/guides): Read practical advice about kitchen products and care.
- [Collections](https://kitchen-reviews-seven.vercel.app/collections): Browse curated kitchen product selections.
- [Kitchen inspiration](https://kitchen-reviews-seven.vercel.app/inspiration): Explore kitchen styles and design ideas.
- [About KitchenTrusted](https://kitchen-reviews-seven.vercel.app/about): Learn about the site's editorial approach.
- [How we choose](https://kitchen-reviews-seven.vercel.app/how-we-choose): Learn how product details are organized and compared, and how affiliate links are disclosed.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://kitchen-reviews-seven.vercel.app/affiliate-disclosure): Learn how affiliate links may support the site.

Product availability, specifications, and prices may change. Verify current details with the retailer before purchasing.
